home.heroDescription: Mental health screening with scientific questionnaires PHQ-9 & GAD-7. Free, private, and only takes 5 minutes.
home.whyDescription: A mental health screening platform designed to help you recognize your mental condition early.
home.ctaDescription: Only takes 5 minutes. Free. Private. Small step for big change.

assessment.instructionPeriod: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?
assessment.question: Question
assessment.errorSave: Failed to save results. Please try again.

questions: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
Feeling tired or having little energy
Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way
Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying
Worrying too much about different things
Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
Feeling afraid as if something awful might happen

phq9.minimal: No intervention needed. Continue positive activities and monitor your condition.
phq9.ringan: Consider light counseling. Try self-help techniques such as regular exercise, mindfulness, and journaling.
phq9.sedang: Consultation with a psychologist is highly recommended. Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) is effective for this level of severity.
phq9.sedang-berat: Immediately consult a psychologist or psychiatrist. Combination therapy (psychotherapy and pharmacotherapy) may be needed.
phq9.berat: MUST consult a psychiatrist immediately. Do not delay seeking professional help.

gad7.minimal: No intervention needed. Practice simple relaxation techniques such as deep breathing.
gad7.ringan: Consider light counseling. Try relaxation techniques, mindfulness, regular exercise, and reduce caffeine intake.
gad7.sedang: Consultation with a psychologist is highly recommended. Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) is effective for managing anxiety. Consider stress management techniques.
gad7.berat: IMMEDIATELY consult a psychologist or psychiatrist. Severe anxiety can interfere with daily function and may require combination therapy.

result.title: Screening Result
result.consultationDesc: Find a psychologist or psychiatrist nearby for further consultation
result.monitorDesc: Take regular screenings every 2-4 weeks to see changes
result.infoPhq9: PHQ-9 is a globally standardized questionnaire for depression screening.
result.infoGad7: GAD-7 is a globally standardized questionnaire for anxiety screening.
result.infoDisclaimer: This result is indicative and not a medical diagnosis.
result.disclaimer: This screening result is NOT a medical diagnosis. If you are experiencing concerning symptoms, please consult a psychologist or psychiatrist immediately.

minimal.symptoms: No or very few depression symptoms that interfere with daily activities.
minimal.impact: Daily functioning remains normal, no significant impairment.
minimal.action: Maintain a healthy lifestyle, exercise regularly, and maintain social connections.

mild.symptoms: Some depression symptoms appear, but can still be managed with self-effort.
mild.impact: There may be slight disruption in activity or productivity.
mild.action: Try self-help techniques such as mindfulness, journaling, or light exercise. Brief counseling may help.

moderate.symptoms: Depression symptoms occur quite often and begin to interfere with daily function.
moderate.impact: Decreased productivity, difficulty enjoying activities that are usually liked.
moderate.action: Consultation with a psychologist is highly recommended. Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) is effective for this level.

moderateSevere.symptoms: Depression symptoms appear almost every day and are very disruptive.
moderateSevere.impact: Difficulty carrying out routine activities, social relationships are disrupted.
moderateSevere.action: Immediately consult a psychologist or psychiatrist. Combination therapy (psychotherapy + medication) may be needed.

severe.symptoms: Severe depression symptoms appear almost every day, possibly including thoughts of self-harm.
severe.impact: Daily function is severely impaired, may not be able to work or attend school.
severe.action: MUST consult a psychiatrist immediately. Do not delay seeking professional help.

minimal.symptoms: No or very few anxiety symptoms that interfere.
minimal.impact: Daily function is normal, no significant problems.
minimal.action: Maintain a healthy lifestyle, practice relaxation techniques such as deep breathing.

mild.symptoms: Some anxiety symptoms appear, such as restlessness or fatigue.
mild.impact: There may be slight disruption in concentration or sleep.
mild.action: Try relaxation techniques, reduce caffeine, exercise regularly, and practice mindfulness.

moderate.symptoms: Anxiety symptoms occur quite often and begin to interfere with activities.
moderate.impact: Difficulty concentrating, sleep disturbances, easily irritated.
moderate.action: Consultation with a psychologist is highly recommended. Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) is effective for managing anxiety.

severe.symptoms: Severe anxiety symptoms appear almost every day, possibly accompanied by panic attacks.
severe.impact: Daily function is severely impaired, difficulty carrying out routine activities.
severe.action: IMMEDIATELY consult a psychologist or psychiatrist. Professional treatment is necessary.
